get.summary: Read administrative patient profile fields only

put.summary: Update administrative fields using optimistic version
put.description: Account linkage is preserved. Legacy address may remain null. Stale version: 409 STALE_VERSION (MSG-16).

get.summary: Read medical history and allergies
get.description: Active PATIENT self/confirmed dependent or active DOCTOR. Temporary R3 doctor relation policy. No stored row returns empty strings and version 0 without inserting.

put.description: CSRF required. Texts are trimmed, then limited to 2000 UTF-16 units. Version 0 creates version 1; matching positive version increments; stale versions return 409. Actor/time are server-owned.

get.summary: Read administrative fields of a confirmed dependent
get.description: Active PATIENT only. VALIDATION_FAILED: MSG-17; CARE_LINK_NOT_AVAILABLE: MSG-21; OTP_INVALID: wrong, expired or unavailable code (MSG-82). Administrative fields only; ownership is checked before link-state disclosure. Mutations require CSRF.

put.summary: Update administrative fields without changing account linkage; no client version required
put.description: Active PATIENT only. VALIDATION_FAILED: MSG-17; CARE_LINK_NOT_AVAILABLE: MSG-21; OTP_INVALID: wrong, expired or unavailable code (MSG-82). Administrative fields only; ownership is checked before link-state disclosure. Mutations require CSRF.

delete.summary: Revoke management access while retaining all clinic records
delete.description: Active PATIENT only. VALIDATION_FAILED: MSG-17; CARE_LINK_NOT_AVAILABLE: MSG-21; OTP_INVALID: wrong, expired or unavailable code (MSG-82). Administrative fields only; ownership is checked before link-state disclosure. Mutations require CSRF.

put.summary: Save or replace the clinic reply
put.description: Trims reply text to 1–1000 characters. Appends REPLY on first save or EDIT_REPLY on overwrite, in the review transaction. Reply is public only while the review is PUBLISHED.

get.summary: Search Clinic Staff accounts
get.description: Literal username substring; external role; ACTIVE/INACTIVE status. Zero-based page, size 1..100 (default 20), newest createdAt then id first.

post.summary: Create a Clinic Staff username account with an Admin-supplied initial password
post.description: Roles: RECEPTIONIST, ORTHOPEDIC_DOCTOR, IMAGING_TECHNICIAN, LAB_TECHNICIAN. The initial password is never returned. First-login password change is required.

post.summary: Reissue a Clinic Staff temporary password once
post.description: Revokes sessions and reset challenges; requires password change. Does not activate or unlock the account. Never cache the response.

post.summary: Deactivate an ACTIVE Clinic Staff account and revoke all sessions

post.description: Clears failed attempts and lock time.

get.summary: Read active and inactive rooms for clinic staff
get.description: Existing room projection ordered by roomCode then id. No search, filter or pagination parameters.

get.summary: List public clinic reviews
get.description: Only PUBLISHED reviews. Response contains no Patient/account/visit identity; summary covers all published reviews, independent of the page, with average rounded to one decimal.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page; clamped to an existing page

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: submittedAt or rating, followed by asc or desc; default submittedAt,desc

400.description: MSG-54: Invalid query, filter, date range or sort

get.summary: Match administrative profiles by exact canonical phone and birth date
get.description: fullName refines only multiple candidates, using normalized exact case-insensitive equality. Zero matches returns empty items. Remaining ambiguity returns 409 PATIENT_MATCH_AMBIGUOUS (MSG-18).

get.summary: List my submitted reviews
get.description: Returns reviews for the current account's own profile, newest submission first, including all moderation states and any clinic reply.

200.description: Unpaged items; patient review content is named text

get.summary: List visits eligible for review
get.description: Returns own CLOSED visits without an existing review. CLOSED corresponds to SRS Completed. No account/profile selector is accepted.

200.description: Unpaged items of eligible visits, newest visit date first

get.summary: List self first, then confirmed and pending dependents in stable order
get.description: Active PATIENT only. VALIDATION_FAILED: MSG-17; CARE_LINK_NOT_AVAILABLE: MSG-21; OTP_INVALID: wrong, expired or unavailable code (MSG-82). Administrative fields only; ownership is checked before link-state disclosure. Mutations require CSRF.

get.summary: List my personal notifications
get.description: Scopes by authenticated recipient, newest createdAt/id first. Related-record availability is recomputed against current access; unavailable records do not remove inbox items.

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: true: unread only; false or omitted: all

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page; clamped to an existing page

400.description: MSG-54: Invalid query, filter, date range or sort

get.summary: Count my unread notifications
get.description: Counts only rows for the authenticated recipient with read_at IS NULL.

List operational upload/send work assigned to this Technician
Get actor-authorized imaging result history
Read a public doctor profile and seven days of availability
get.description: Dates run from today through today + 6 in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. hasOpenTime is true if any assigned public-bookable service has a public slot. Non-accepting doctors have seven false values; hidden/inactive profiles remain 404.

get.description: Returns review content, visit context, clinic reply and server-calculated lowercase allowedActions.

404.description: MSG-50: Record missing or unavailable to the current account

text.description: JSON string only; 1–1000 Unicode code points after trim

ReviewDetail.description: Admin review plus nullable reply; allowedActions depend on state and reply existence

SubmitReviewRequest.description: Own completed visit review. Account/profile and allowedActions are never client inputs.

rating.description: JSON integer only; decimal/string coercion is rejected

text.description: JSON string only; 10–1000 Unicode code points after trim

MyReview.description: Patient projection; review text is named text, including all moderation states

ReviewPatient.description: Private projection; task scope returns relationship SELF only

NotificationItem.description: Recipient-only inbox projection; persistence fields type/read_at/recipient_account_id are not exposed

NotificationRelatedRecord.description: Polymorphic reference, not related-record data. REVIEW is supported by backend; FE union update is deferred.

available.description: Computed on read: record exists AND current account can access it; never stored

PublicReview.description: Published-only projection. No Patient, account or visit identifiers; clinicReply is null if absent.

PublicReviewPage.description: Zero-based page, size 1–100; summary is independent of pagination

ReviewSummary.description: Entire PUBLISHED population; average rounded to one decimal, average/count zero when empty

ReviewableVisit.description: Own CLOSED visit without a review

NotificationPage.description: Zero-based page with newest createdAt/id first; totalPages is at least one

ReviewCounts.description: Global counts, independent of filters and page

ReviewListItem.description: Admin projection uses content. Server actions: approve/hide/unhide/reply/editReply.
